reason: This text is the Song of Moses (Exodus 15), a triumphant hymn celebrating God's deliverance of the Israelites from the Red Sea. The passage expresses praise and gratitude ('I will sing to the LORD, for He has triumphed gloriously'), celebrates God's strength and power ('Your right hand, O LORD, glorious in power'), and acknowledges God's guidance ('You led in Your mercy the people whom You have redeemed'). There is no expression of blame toward leaders or toward Yahweh for putting them at risk. Rather, the Israelites are celebrating their rescue FROM risk and danger.
